scope: Validate SDK transaction evidence before returning it or logging a finalized transition. Accept lowercase 32/33-byte hex identifiers and exact non-negative integer block heights.

baseline.note: Failures include invalid evidence previously accepted and null/missing evidence producing inconsistent errors.

coverage: Malformed result shapes/identifiers and negative, fractional, non-finite, unsafe numeric or non-canonical string heights do not produce a finalized log.
Valid txId/txHash fallback accepts 32/33-byte identifiers, zero and canonical decimal heights beyond safe JS number precision without numeric conversion.
Role-session generated-circuit regression uses valid synthetic identifiers instead of simulator-prefixed strings.
limits: Shape validation is not independent finality or inclusion verification. An invalid result can follow an actual broadcast; callers must preserve existing uncertainty and avoid automatic retry.
No new native-wallet, browser, container or complete workspace regression.
The shared evidence function also handles deployment results; new malformed-data cases exercise transition results.
